stories.title: Brewers escape as Padres' potential go-ahead HR hits roof, falls for out
stories.summary: The Brewers eked out a Game 1 win in their NLDS series after the American Family Field roof impeded what the Padres thought was going to be a go-ahead home run in the ninth.

stories.title: Rasmussen sweeps Yankees' lefties aside in near-perfect Game 1
stories.summary: Drew Rasmussen and Bryan Baker pitched a one-hit game Saturday night as the Rays shut down the Yankees' offense to take Game 1 of their ALDS series.

stories.title: Sullivan, 17, becomes youngest USMNT scorer with stunner in win vs. Mexico
stories.summary: Rising star Cavan Sullivan became the youngest scorer in United States men's national team history after the teenager found the net with a stunning effort from distance in Saturday's friendly against rival Mexico.

stories.title: Smith to Heisman voters after record day: 'I'm the best player in the country'
stories.summary: Jeremiah Smith likely cemented himself as the Heisman front-runner with another monster performance in which he also became Ohio State's career receptions and touchdown receptions leader during Saturday's 31-14 win over Iowa.

stories.title: UFC 332 smashes record with nine first-round knockouts, 11 total finishes
stories.summary: It was a record-setting night at UFC 332, which featured nine first-round knockouts and 11 total finishes, both the most on a single card.
